purpose: Machine-readable agentic settlement contract for DreamLedger offers.

positioning.vs_traditional_marketplace: No DreamLedger success fee or listing fee on current offers. Buyer pays listed NZD price via Stripe; network/processor fees are Stripe's, not a platform skim.
positioning.agentic: Agents discover offers via catalog APIs, present checkout_url to a human or authorized agent wallet path, and treat settlement as external Stripe evidence only.

fee_policy.processor_fees: As charged by Stripe to the merchant account; not added as a separate DreamLedger fee line on these offers.
fee_policy.note: Contrast with high take-rate consumer marketplaces. DreamLedger's current public offers are direct Stripe Payment Links at the listed price.

settlement_spine.live_authority: Stripe live Checkout Session (paid, livemode, NZD)
settlement_spine.meter: GitHub Commerce Settlement Sync → proof/commerce artifact

protocol_map.comment: Industry agentic payment stack mapped to what DreamLedger runs today vs later.

industry: AP2 (Google/FIDO) — proof buyer authorized agent spend
authorization_layer.dreamledger_today: Human completes Stripe Checkout, or buyer explicitly initiates Payment Link; no autonomous spend without that handoff.

checkout_layer.dreamledger_today: Published checkout_url per offer; agents should open/return the Stripe Payment Link rather than inventing a parallel cart.

machine_payment_layer.dreamledger_today: Not enabled on production storefront. Future rail only after catalog + meter support a second settlement authority.
machine_payment_layer.dreamledger_later: Optional x402/MPP for digital micropay SKUs; escrow (e.g. x402B-style) for high-trust physical/service delivery.

marketplace_orderbook_layer.dreamledger_today: Fixed-price catalog listings (off-chain catalog, Stripe settlement). No secondary order book yet.
marketplace_orderbook_layer.design_rule: Prefer open catalog + deterministic settlement over locked monolithic fee extraction.

purchase_loop_for_agents: Present offer name, price_nzd, currency, checkout_url to the authorizing human
Human (or authorized path) completes Stripe Payment Link
Do not mark revenue until live paid session exists and fulfilment evidence is sealed
Optional: poll merchant settlement workflows; never invent cs_ or verified_revenue
